svg.title: Where VirtualPyTest uses AI, in one image
svg.text: Most of the lab needs no AI.
AI is asked only where nothing simpler can decide.
the shortest path in the tree
AI only helps Localize when a match is doubtful.
So a person only looks at real problems
A frozen menu, a sleeping phone, a network blink.
When the fingerprint is not sure
It only confirms a doubtful answer.
A person reviews what is written.
Questions about the tool, a screen or a run
From a paid model to a 0.25 ms classifier
See the poster Freeze: menu or stuck video?
AI only where nothing simpler can decide.
Every AI answer is logged and counted.
